TRANSLATION

US helicopter exercises announced in West Middle Franconia

The US Army will conduct helicopter landing exercises in the district of Neustadt an der Aisch-Bad Windsheim. According to the district office, this has been announced by the American armed forces. Residents are entitled to compensation in case of damage.

Especially the Middle Franconian communities of Markt Erlbach, Gallmersgarten and Uffenheim will be affected by the US helicopter exercises. Night landings are also planned.

According to the plan, the exercises will last the whole of December. The population is asked to stay away from the facilities of the exercising troops.

Claims for compensation for damage to fields and forests, for damage to private roads and paths, and for other damage must be reported in writing to the local authority immediately, but no later than one month after the end of the exercise, according to the District Office.

Annoyance about US exercises

In the past, there has been repeated criticism from the Franconian population of the US Army's exercise maneuvers in the region. Especially the night flights with US combat helicopters recently caused displeasure.

Last year, the emergency landing of a helicopter in the Ansbach district in the immediate vicinity of a housing estate had again sparked the discussion about the exercises of the US troops in Franconia.
